profile.headline: Software Engineer @ LaunchDarkly
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer focused on building scalable backend systems for AI applications, particularly where LLMs need to work reliably in production.

My experience centers around GenAI systems, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation pipelines, and agent-based workflows. At Oracle, I designed and deployed a production-grade RAG system that improved developer productivity by 50%, while also building evaluation frameworks to measure retrieval quality and LLM performance beyond surface-level metrics  .

I’ve worked across the full stack of AI systems—from fine-tuning embedding models and optimizing retrieval pipelines to building RESTful APIs and integrating observability tooling. A major focus of my work has been improving system reliability: increasing retrieval consistency, reducing hallucinations through prompt design, and implementing human-in-the-loop evaluation workflows.

I’m especially interested in backend and platform engineering challenges where AI systems must be scalable, observable, and controllable—not just functional. I enjoy contributing to system design discussions, understanding tradeoffs in distributed systems, and taking ownership of production systems over time.

Outside of engineering, I’m also a photographer and content creator, focused on sports, automotive, and cinematic storytelling.

- Manage full creative workflow — from concept and production to post-processing and delivery — ensuring brand consistency across channels.
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe Lightroom · Adobe Photoshop · DaVinci Resolve · Photography · Videography

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Designed and deployed a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system, improving developer self-sufficiency and increasing productivity by 50%
- Designed and implemented a human-in-the-loop (HITL) and automated evaluation framework for LLM and retrieval systems using ragas and Langfuse, reducing iteration time by 30% 
Integrated metric generation with Langfuse, creating an internal tool to quickly view metrics and manage test datasets
- Architected and optimized a high-performance retrieval pipeline using OpenSearch, including data preprocessing, indexing strategies, and query optimization, achieving 100% retrieval consistency and 90% context relevancy
- Finetuned bi-encoder retrieval models using Sentence Transformers and custom datasets improving information retrieval accuracy from 88% to 95%. 
- Conducted Prompt Engineering to guide LLM in accurate and concise answer generation decreasing hallucinations, drastically.
- Built an agent-based AI system for CRM automation using Google ADK, reducing development time by 60% through automated task execution and workflow orchestration

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-  Exploratory Analysis and Testing of GenAI model performance pertaining to Siebel Development using LangChain
Developed a library for handling transformations between different Open API specifications, resulting in a 60% speed up.
 - Created Microservice Adapters to transfer information between monolithic data services.
-  Deployed micro services using Docker and Kubernetes
 - Performed unit testing using Mockito and feature testing using Behave Feature files.
-  Creating low code application POCs using Oracle Apex to facilitate the modernization of monolithic systems and increase revenue.

positions.title: Data Science and Machine Learning Research Intern
positions.description:
Contributed to an ongoing study in Dr. Akane Sano’s lab (Rice University), predicting loneliness in Alzheimer Care Giver’s 
-	Developed Machine Learning Classification Models to predict Loneliness in Alzheimer’s Patient workers and other caregivers
-	Achieved 81% accuracy when predicting whether a caregiver was lonely or not lonely using data standardization, k -folds validation, and stratification
-	Created Feature Engineering Pipelines for computing relevant features from participant Fitbit Data and Phone Data
-	Implemented Data Science techniques by computing features from participant mobile surveys
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Data Science · Machine Learning · Data Engineering · Research and Development (R&D) · Research Skills · Python (Programming Language) · TensorFlow
